label: Gender (child)
description: A child's gender: girl, boy, trans girl, trans boy or non-binary child. Each value stands for the adult gender it is tagged with (the gender facet), so a child's words narrowed on the adult gender list keep the same values here.
notes: Seeds a child's variants in place of person.gender, one value per variant by the same shares, when the person reads as a child (the who rule's stages). Its values are the gender list's, said of a child: a child is written as a girl or a boy, never a woman or a man. Not a slot's list; the chooser offers person.gender, and a pick maps here by its gender tag.
